content.text: You're a digital creator in Zimbabwe, and you've just been rejected by Stripe. Again. You've tried Gumroad, Payhip, and other platforms, but they all charge too much or block your transactions. You're not alone – thousands of creators in Africa, Asia, and Latin America face the same problem. The solution lies not in workarounds, but in building your own sovereign digital commerce stack – a secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure that lets you sell digital products with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-3|USDT Payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-3|crypto]], without relying on restrictive platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-2. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, but with NOWPayments, you can sell your ebooks, courses, and templates for as low as 0.5% per transaction. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. That's a significant advantage, especially when you consider the scalability and reliability of your own infrastructure. By building your own sovereign stack, you can avoid platform fees, data ownership issues, and the risk of being blocked or restricted – and focus on growing your business, not wrestling with payment gateways.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start building your sovereign stack, you'll need to choose a hosting platform, a backend service for order storage and file delivery, and a payment gateway that supports your preferred cryptocurrencies. You'll also need to select a set of tools and templates to help you build, deploy, and scale your infrastructure. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is an excellent resource for this – it includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and everything you need to get started. Once you have your tools and templates in place, you can begin deploying your stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend service, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You'll also need to configure your file delivery system, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to automatically deliver your digital products to customers upon payment confirmation. This pipeline is the heart of your sovereign stack, and it's essential to get it right to ensure seamless transactions and customer satisfaction.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you keep 100% of your revenue and avoid platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This is an exciting moment, and it's essential to test your pipeline thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. You can use a sandbox environment to test your transactions, and once you're confident that everything is working correctly, you can switch to a production environment and start accepting real transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This means adding more servers, increasing storage capacity, and optimizing your pipeline for high-traffic periods. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes resources and templates to help you scale your infrastructure, and with a little practice and patience, you can achieve high levels of scalability and reliability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to ask is: How do I avoid platform fees and data ownership issues when selling digital products? The answer is simple: build your own sovereign digital commerce stack using tools like NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Apps Script. This infrastructure lets you sell digital products with crypto, without relying on restrictive platforms, and keeps 100% of your revenue.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on building a sovereign digital commerce stack, be sure to check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197) – it includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and everything you need to get started. You can also visit our product shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more resources and tools to help you build and deploy your stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Choose a hosting platform and backend service, select a payment gateway that supports your preferred cryptocurrencies, integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend service, configure your file delivery system, test your pipeline in a sandbox environment, and once you're confident that everything is working correctly, switch to a production environment and start accepting real transactions. Be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for more resources and templates to help you build and deploy your stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my chosen backend service?

To integrate NOWPayments with your chosen backend service, you'll need to follow the documentation provided by NOWPayments and your chosen backend service. This may involve setting up a webhook, configuring API keys, and writing custom code to integrate the two services.
Can I use a different payment gateway than NOWPayments?

Yes, you can use a different payment gateway than NOWPayments, but keep in mind that you'll need to ensure that the gateway supports your preferred cryptocurrencies and integrates seamlessly with your chosen backend service.
How do I configure my file delivery system to automatically deliver digital products to customers?

To configure your file delivery system to automatically deliver digital products to customers, you'll need to set up a webhook to trigger file delivery upon payment confirmation, and then write custom code to deliver the files to customers.
What happens if I encounter issues with my pipeline?
If you encounter issues with your pipeline, be sure to troubleshoot the problem carefully, and if necessary, seek help from the documentation, a community forum, or a professional developer.
Can I customize my sovereign stack to meet my specific needs?

Yes, you can customize your sovereign stack to meet your specific needs by using the tools and templates provided in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and writing custom code to tailor the stack to your requirements.
Building a sovereign digital commerce stack is a one-time investment that pays off in scalability and reliability.
